name: sgsits-virtual-campus
description: SGSITS interactive campus map and 360 panorama tour

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix apps/backend && npm install --prefix apps/frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix apps/backend" "npm run dev --prefix apps/frontend"
scripts.render:build: npm install --prefix apps/backend && npm run db:generate:prod --prefix apps/backend && npm run db:push:prod --prefix apps/backend && npm run db:seed --prefix apps/backend
